name: read_arxiv_html_formulas
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import re,html
b=open("inputs/sources/bunkbed.bytes","rb").read().decode("utf8","replace")
print(len(b))
# turn <math ... alttext="X"...>...</math> into $X$, then strip tags
t=re.sub(r'<math[^>]*alttext="([^"]*)"[^>]*>.*?</math>',lambda m:"$"+html.unescape(m.group(1))+"$",b,flags=re.S)
t=re.sub(r"<style.*?</style>|<script.*?</script>"," ",t,flags=re.S)
t=re.sub(r"<[^>]+>"," ",t)
t=html.unescape(t); t=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",t)
open("results/arxiv-v1-with-formulas.txt","w").write(t)
print(len(t))
for key in ["Definition 1.1","Definition 1.2","Definition 1.4","Model 4.1","Conjecture 6.4"]:
    i=t.find(key)
    print("-----",key,i)
i=t.find("Definition 1.1"); print(t[i:i+3900])
